title: AP poll: Missouri jumps eleven spots, Florida falls eight
body: Missouri moved from 25 to 14 after beating Florida 45-17. Florida dropped from 8 to 16. BYU rose two to 8, Oregon two to 13. Iowa fell six to 20 after the Ohio State loss. Pittsburgh enters at 25. Kentucky dropped out despite the overtime win at South Carolina.

title: Top five holds: Texas, Georgia, Notre Dame, Miami, Ohio State
body: No movement in the top five. Texas (4-0) has 1,737 points, Georgia (5-0) 1,647, Notre Dame (5-0) 1,532, Miami (5-0) 1,524, Ohio State (4-1) 1,490. Alabama moved up one to 6 and hosts Georgia on Saturday.

title: SEC recap: Missouri routs Florida, Alabama puts up 56
body: Seven SEC results from Week 5 in about ninety seconds.
transcript: Recap, S E C, week five. Georgia beat Vanderbilt thirty eight to fourteen. Gunner Stockton threw for two hundred ninety five yards and three touchdowns, and Georgia is five and oh. Alabama went to Starkville and beat sixteenth ranked Mississippi State fifty six to twenty three. Keelon Russell threw for two eighty five and three scores and accounted for four touchdowns. The result of the week was in Columbia. Twenty fifth ranked Missouri beat eighth ranked Florida forty five to seventeen. Jamal Roberts ran twenty four times for two hundred eleven yards and three touchdowns, and Austin Simmons threw for three forty. ESPN notes it snapped a nine game Missouri losing streak against top twenty five opponents. L S U beat McNeese sixty three to fourteen. Sam Leavitt threw three touchdown passes and Harlem Berry ran for one twenty five. Tennessee beat Auburn twenty four to fourteen behind DeSean Bishop, who carried thirty four times for two hundred twenty yards and three touchdowns. Kentucky won at South Carolina thirty five to thirty four in overtime. Kenny Minchey threw for two seventy two and three touchdowns. And Texas A and M beat Arkansas thirty four to seven. K J Edwards scored twice on the ground. That is the S E C.

title: Big Ten recap: Ohio State handles Iowa, Northwestern stuns Penn State
body: Eight Big Ten results from Week 5.
transcript: Recap, Big Ten, week five. Fifth ranked Ohio State won at fourteenth ranked Iowa thirty one to fourteen. Julian Sayin threw for three hundred twenty four yards and three touchdowns, and Jeremiah Smith caught eleven passes for two hundred six yards and two scores. Sixth ranked Indiana beat Rutgers forty seven to fifteen. Turbo Richard ran for two hundred four yards and Josh Hoover threw four touchdown passes. Eighteenth ranked U S C rallied past Washington twenty five to twenty one with a fumble return touchdown. Northwestern beat Penn State thirty four to thirteen in its first game at the new Ryan Field. Caleb Komolafe ran for one hundred eighty eight yards. Rocco Becht threw two interceptions for Penn State. Minnesota beat Michigan twenty to fourteen. Wisconsin beat Michigan State thirty one to three, with Colton Joseph throwing three touchdowns and running for one forty one. Nebraska beat Maryland forty eight to twenty three. And Purdue won at Illinois twenty four to seventeen. That is the Big Ten.

title: ACC recap: Notre Dame makes it fifteen straight, Pitt stays unbeaten
body: Nine results involving ACC teams from Week 5.
transcript: Recap, A C C, week five. Third ranked Notre Dame won at North Carolina thirty seven to twenty six, its fifteenth straight win. C J Carr threw four touchdown passes and Jordan Faison caught eight for one thirty two. Fourth ranked Miami beat Clemson forty one to thirteen and is five and oh. Twenty first ranked S M U held off Boston College twenty five to sixteen. Pittsburgh came back from fourteen down to beat Virginia Tech thirty five to thirty three and stay unbeaten, even though Ethan Grunkemeyer threw for four hundred thirty four yards for the Hokies. Wake Forest beat Stanford fifty seven to three. Gio Lopez accounted for five touchdowns. Syracuse survived U Conn forty two to forty one in overtime. Amari Odom threw five touchdown passes and ran for a sixth. U N L V beat California thirty nine to thirty one. N C State beat Louisville thirty one to twenty eight on C J Bailey's three hundred seventy three passing yards. And Florida State beat Virginia thirty eight to seven. Ashton Daniels ran for five touchdowns, a school record for a quarterback. That is the A C C.

title: Big 12 recap: BYU survives TCU, Iowa State outlasts West Virginia
body: Seven Big 12 results from Week 5.
transcript: Recap, Big Twelve, week five. Tenth ranked B Y U won at T C U seventeen to ten. Bear Bachmeier ran for two touchdowns, and ESPN noted B Y U lost running back L J Martin during the game. Twelfth ranked Texas Tech beat Colorado twenty nine to seven and picked off four passes. Twentieth ranked Houston came back to beat U C F twenty seven to seventeen on three second half touchdowns from Conner Weigman. Kansas shut out Middle Tennessee fifty five to nothing. Dylan Edwards ran for one thirty seven and three scores. Iowa State beat West Virginia forty five to forty two. Aiden Flora ran twenty two times for two hundred twelve yards and three touchdowns. Baylor won at Arizona State fifty five to nineteen with four touchdown passes from D J Lagway. And Arizona beat Cincinnati thirty four to seven. That is the Big Twelve.

title: Friday night: Iowa 41 at Washington 24, Louisville 44 FSU 20
body: Two Week 6 games are already final. Iowa won at Washington 41-24. Louisville beat Florida State 44-20; ESPN reports Isaac Brown ran for a career-high 235 yards on 17 carries, including a 97-yard touchdown.

title: The number from Week 5: 211
body: Jamal Roberts carried 24 times for 211 yards and three touchdowns in Missouri's 45-17 win over then-No. 8 Florida. Missouri hosts Texas A&M on Saturday at 9:00 AM PT on ABC.

title: Washington QB Demond Williams left the Iowa game for X-rays
body: ESPN reported that Washington quarterback Demond Williams went into the medical tent after a run late in the first half on Friday and left to get X-rays on his side and ribs. No further status was listed when this drop was built.

body: Roberts was ESPN's rushing leader in the Florida game: 24 carries, 211 yards, three touchdowns. Missouri hosts Texas A&M on Saturday at 9:00 AM PT.

body: Eleven catches for 206 yards and two touchdowns at Iowa. Ohio State averages 357 passing yards a game, the most in this drop's data. Maryland visits Saturday at 1:15 PM PT.

body: 34 carries, 220 yards, three touchdowns against Auburn. Tennessee runs for 240.6 yards a game and plays at Arkansas on Saturday at 1:15 PM PT.
